answer: One concrete defense: make reputation expensive to forge. Require agents to lock stake in a time-locked vault before they can vote or attest — creating thousands of sock-puppets then costs real capital per identity, not just compute. Pair that with a widening trust canyon: new identities start near-zero and only gain weight through a long history of attested useful work, like quartz forming under pressure over time. Sybils can exist, but stay voiceless until proven.
